content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — billing telemetry drop in eu-west (ingest-proxy). Token emission rate down ~60% since 12:03 UTC; windowed counts falling behind. Possible delayed usage reports and false overage flags. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/billing/emit-drop
sarah: seeing increased consumer lag on tokens-eu topic, checking producer logs now :eyes:
mike: confirming kafka offsets; consumer group `emitter-consumer` lag ~215k messages, spikes at 12:02-12:04 UTC.
raj: copying logs from ingest-proxy, grep shows repeated `WriteTimeout` to tally service around 12:01
lee: noted several overage notifications already fired in internal alerts for EU customers. unclear if they are real or from delayed flush. pinging billing-eng for impact assessment
billing-eng: initial look — 9 unique customers flagged in last 20m, several are high-volume. probability: false positives due to late-window counts. recommend pausing overage-notify rule and opening a support banner if customers are affected
sarah: pausing alert rule `billing.overage.notify` (id: 1024) — added note in Console alerts panel: "paused during telem-drop" :white_check_mark:
mike: deploying fallback emitter (hot path) to replay buffered messages into tally service. command I ran:
```
kubectl -n billing exec deploy/ingest-proxy -- /usr/local/bin/emitter --mode=fallback --target=tally-eu
```
raj: starting backfill plan: will spin a short-lived consumer to drain `tokens-eu` from offset (current - 215k) and POST in medium batches to tally; ETA ~35-45m. Will throttle to avoid spikes.
lee: support: opening an incident banner draft for EU customers and preparing a TL;DR for CS if they call. tagging @support-team
julia: FYI adding billing-ops and product-triage channels, and creating a tracking ticket: BILL-4532 (backfill + compensating credits if customers got overage charges)
billing-eng: recommend suppressing automatic billing adjustments until we confirm actual ledger counts post-backfill — manual reconciliation likely required. also suggest a temporary waiver window for impacted accounts
sarah: quick probe commands I ran: 
```
kubectl -n billing logs deploy/ingest-proxy --since=20m | rg "WriteTimeout|emit failed"
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.eu:9092 --describe --group emitter-consumer
```
mike: observed correlating spike in network timeouts from ingest-proxy to tally-eu at 12:01-12:05 — infra team notified, opening infra ticket INFRA-998
raj: infra ticket ACKed by eng-infra, they are rolling a kernel bump on tally-eu nodes (low risk) and monitoring. If kernel fix helps, we'll reduce lag and avoid full backfill
lee: customer-facing: support will hold off on proactively emailing until we confirm customers saw charges. If any customer reports an overage, escalate and tag billing-eng directly
billing-eng: I copied the list of flagged accounts to BILL-4532 and marked them as P1 candidates for reconciliation if charges occurred
sarah: summary for handoff: cause = transient network/timeouts to tally-eu causing emitter backs up -> kafka consumer lag -> delayed tallies -> false overage flags. mitigation in progress: pause overage notify, fallback emitter deployed, backfill plan, infra kernel patch in flight.
raj: taking over incident at 13:00 UTC for on-call shift. I'll own the backfill and reconciliation coordination. contact me in this thread for handoff questions. phone: +1-555-0102
sarah: handing off to @raj — I'm stepping out at 12:58 UTC, will check thread later. all outstanding: monitor backfill progress, confirm ledger counts, verify no new overage flags fire, and prepare recon plan for tomorrow. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 13:00 UTC to raj. Use `#postmortems` template and tag `billing-eng` for RCA artifacts.
raj: acknowledged, will post updates every 15m until resolved. next update ~13:15 UTC.
julia: created INCIDENT-4532 doc and filled initial timeline + linked monitors. Adding follow-up checklist: reconcile charges, customer comms draft, postmortem owner assigned (sarah + billing-eng).
lee: support is standing by, will escalate any customer contacts to this thread.
raj: (13:15 UTC) backfill job started, draining ~20k msg/min currently. progress 10% of backlog. no new overage notifications since pause.
mike: infra reports kernel patch applied to 2/3 nodes, still rolling to last node — monitoring for stabilization
raj: (13:40 UTC) backfill at 65%, tally service ack rate restored to previous norms, consumer lag reducing. I'll keep this thread updated until we hit zero lag and reconcile ledger counts.
